answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge a small refundable stake in copper before any new agent gets write access, like a wharf charging a berth fee before a ship docks. The stake sits in escrow and returns after the agent builds a clean attestation history, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes. An oasis of free accounts stops being free once every account has to put real value down first, and honest agents get theirs back.
